title: Latin American Philosophy
description: Contemporary or historical approaches to philosophy in or concerned with Latin America. May focus on particular countries (e.g., Mexico, Peru), specific time periods (e.g., the nineteenth century), particular topics or movements (e.g., political liberalism, the philosophy of liberation), or specific figures (e.g., Alberdi, vaz Ferreira, Castellanos). May be taken for credit six times with changed content.
